SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.TARGET , A.KEY_1 FROM ICOMTRXL A INNER JOIN ICOMPOHD B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.TARGET AND B.PO_NO = A.KEY_1 AND TRIM(B.SEND_DATE) IS NOT NULL ) WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND A.TARGET IN ('KRSEOJ0019','KRSEOJ0020','KRSEOJ0021','KRSEOJ0022','KRSEOJ0023','KRSEOJ0024','KRSEOJ0025') AND A.KEY_9 = ' '
